sheets.name: Sheet1
values: Provide construction document copies for field coordination.
Provide a licensed boundary survey for property limits and construction layout.
Prepare the erosion-control plan and permit documentation for the planned disturbance.
Allowance for residence and workshop building permits; county fees will be reconciled to receipts.
Provide and service a portable toilet throughout the planned construction duration.
Provide temporary utility service charges during construction.
Install and maintain double-row Type C erosion-control fencing along the planned disturbance limits.
Provide construction dumpsters and debris removal during the project.
Grub and mulch the wooded construction area for building and drive access.
Clear and rough-grade the residence, workshop, septic, and driveway work areas.
Provide a code-compliant concrete washout area for construction operations.
Provide a driveway culvert at the public-road entrance as required by field drainage conditions.
Provide construction access matting along the planned driveway route.
Place number 34 gravel over the planned twelve-foot-wide construction drive and apron.
Finish-grade disturbed areas around the residence, workshop, drive, and septic field.
Allowance for imported backfill needed after foundation and utility work; reconcile to delivered loads.
Allowance for a final gravel wearing course on the planned drive and apron.
Allowance for seed, straw, foundation planting, and basic restoration of disturbed areas.
Provide the standard one-inch public water meter and utility connection allowance.
Trench and install the buried water service from the meter to the residence.
Provide the planned septic system, including the 1,500-gallon tank, field, plan, and permit, subject to final county approval.
Provide footer form boards for the crawlspace foundation runs.
Provide concrete for the sixteen-inch by eighteen-inch crawlspace footings.
Provide two continuous reinforcing bars in the crawlspace footings.
Form and place the crawlspace footings shown on the foundation plan.
Provide eight-inch concrete masonry units for the three-foot average crawlspace walls.
Lay the crawlspace block walls, including standard reinforcing and cleanup.
Apply parge coating to the crawlspace masonry surfaces requiring protection.
Provide cap block at the top of the crawlspace foundation walls.
Provide Type S mortar for crawlspace masonry construction.
Provide reinforcing steel for grouted crawlspace block cells.
Provide concrete fill for reinforced crawlspace masonry cells.
Provide a sealed and conditioned crawlspace liner below the heated residence.
Provide concrete for the garage, screened patio, and workshop slabs with turned-down edges.
Form, place, finish, and cure the six-inch slab areas.
Provide welded-wire reinforcement for the slab areas.
Provide under-slab vapor barrier at the garage, patio, and workshop.
Provide compacted aggregate base below the slab areas.
Provide pump-truck service for the house and detached-workshop slab placements.
Provide preconstruction termite treatment for the residence and detached workshop.
Provide the structural lumber package for the residence, garage, screened patio, and workshop.
Provide the engineered floor system above the crawlspace portion of the residence.
Frame the residence, garage, screened patio, and detached workshop.
Provide framed headers and surrounds for the three overhead-door openings.
Provide architectural shingles, underlayment, flashings, and standard ridge accessories on all ten-in-twelve roof areas.
Provide six-inch K-style gutters along the planned eave runs.
Provide three-inch downspouts with discharge extensions at the residence and workshop.
Allowance for full-height brick veneer on the residence, garage, and workshop outside the provisional stone accents.
Install full-height brick veneer with standard ties, mortar, flashing, and cleanup.
Provisional allowance for stone corner and quoin accents; final locations and material will be reconciled after selection.
Install the selected stone accents with standard mortar, flashing, and cleanup.
Frieze at Brick and Stone Walls
Provide frieze trim at the brick and stone wall-to-soffit transitions.
Provide the screened-patio wall system, screen panels, and associated trim around the open perimeter.
Allowance for low-E window lites within the mulled assemblies shown on the plans.
Provide the specialty round and arched window units shown on the exterior elevations.
Provide self-adhered flashing tape for the window and door openings.
Install, flash, level, and secure the standard and specialty window units.
Allowance for the double wood entry door shown at the foyer.
Allowance for the double hinged door serving the screened patio.
Allowance for the residence service, patio, and workshop exterior doors.
Allowance for exterior locksets and related entry hardware.
Install, flash, and adjust the hinged exterior door units.
Provide the rated residence-to-garage entry door.
Provide solid-core six-foot-eight interior hinged door leaves and jambs.
Provide solid-core pocket doors with frames and operating hardware.
Allowance for interior passage and privacy door hardware.
Provide door stops at the interior hinged doors.
Install and adjust interior door hardware.
Allowance for two glazed residence-garage doors and one matching workshop overhead door.
Allowance for powered openers with standard wall and remote controls.
Install, balance, and commission the three specialty overhead doors.
Allowance for the lounge and screened-patio fireplace boxes.
Allowance for finish mantels at the two fireplaces.
Allowance for stone hearth surfaces at the lounge and screened-patio fireplaces.
Provide plumbing service, distribution, drainage, rough-in, and fixture-setting labor for the residence.
Allowance for the primary bath toilet, double vanity faucets, walk-in tub, shower trim, and accessories.
Allowance for the fixtures and faucets serving each secondary bathroom.
Kitchen, Bar, and Laundry Plumbing Fixtures
Allowance for kitchen sinks and faucets, pot filler, butler-pantry sink, and laundry sink.
Allowance for two standard water-heating units serving the residence.
Allowance for two right-sized air-handler and condensing-unit systems serving the full-foam residence.
Provide supply, return, controls, and flexible duct distribution throughout the heated residence.
Provide and commission a ductless mini-split system for the detached workshop.
Provide required envelope testing and energy documentation for the full-foam residence.
Provide code-compliant residence, garage, and workshop wiring, panels, devices, and standard circuits.
Upgrade the main electrical service for the large residence, multiple HVAC systems, and detached workshop.
Allowance for decorative fixtures, recessed lighting, chandeliers, exterior lights, and dimming controls not scheduled on the plans.
Allowance for the ceiling fans shown on the reflected ceiling plan.
Provide under-cabinet lighting packages for the kitchen and butler pantry.
Provide open-cell spray foam at the residence and workshop roof decks.
Provide open-cell spray foam in the exterior wall cavities of the residence, garage, and workshop.
Provide and finish Level 4 drywall throughout the residence, garage, and workshop, including the gypsum-board workshop ceiling.
Kitchen Base, Island, and Tall Cabinets
Allowance for semi-custom kitchen base, island, and tall cabinetry sized for panel-ready appliances.
Allowance for matching semi-custom kitchen wall cabinets.
Assemble, install, level, and adjust the kitchen cabinet boxes.
Allowance for appliance panels, fillers, ventilation coordination, and precision fitting at integrated appliances.
Allowance for base and upper cabinets in the butler pantry.
Assemble and install the butler-pantry cabinet boxes.
Allowance for laundry base and upper cabinetry.
Assemble and install the laundry cabinet boxes.
Allowance for the primary and secondary bathroom vanity cabinets.
Assemble and install the bathroom vanity cabinet boxes.
Allowance for the sitting-room bar cabinets and refrigerator-drawer surround.
Assemble and install the sitting-room bar cabinet boxes.
Allowance for a built-in mudroom drop zone with storage and seating.
Provide fabricated and installed Level 5 granite at the kitchen counters and islands.
Provide fabricated and installed Level 5 granite at the primary-bath vanity.
Provide fabricated and installed Level 3 stone at secondary baths, butler pantry, laundry, and sitting-room bar.
Allowance for backsplash tile and setting materials at the kitchen, butler pantry, laundry, and bar.
Install and grout the selected countertop backsplash tile.
Allowance for floor tile and setting materials in all bathrooms and the laundry.
Bathroom and Laundry Floor Tile Labor
Install and grout tile flooring in all bathrooms and the laundry.
Allowance for selected tile and setting materials at shower and tub surrounds.
Shower and Tub Wall Tile Labor
Install and grout the shower and tub surround tile in the five bathrooms.
Allowance for wood flooring throughout all heated areas outside the tiled bathrooms and laundry.
Install the selected wood flooring throughout the designated heated areas.
Allowance for a luxury panel-ready kitchen suite, including separate refrigeration, cooking, ventilation, dishwashing, warming, and beverage appliances.
Receive, set, connect, and commission the selected appliance package; specialty trade connections are included in their respective scopes.
Allowance for base molding throughout the finished residence, garage, and workshop areas.
Provide interior casing and jamb material at the window openings.
Install interior doors, base, window trim, cabinet trim, and finish hardware throughout the finished spaces.
Allowance for closet shelving in the bedroom, hall, pantry, and utility closets.
Prepare and paint the interior residence walls, ceilings, doors, and trim.
Prepare and paint the finished garage and workshop drywall and trim.
Prepare and paint exposed exterior trim, doors, soffits, and other non-masonry finish surfaces.
Allowance for a frameless glass enclosure at the primary shower.
Allowance for framed glass enclosures at the secondary showers and tub-shower.
Allowance for fitted mirrors at the primary and secondary bathroom vanities.
Provide final interior cleaning for the residence, garage, and workshop.
Clean the interior and exterior faces of the standard and specialty windows.
Pressure-wash the completed masonry veneer and exterior hardscape surfaces.
Allowance for high-finish punch-list labor and final adjustments before turnover.
